name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
description: The runner and sleeping first builder were killed after five seconds; restarting on the same store resumed R-1 to passed. Both launches recorded the same session identity, and progress contained exactly one each of stamp, pin, checklist, first self-check, fence and regenerate.
